Officer's narrative
On arrival at the signalized intersection in Pasadena, Texas, I found a side-impact collision between two passenger
vehicles. Driver 1 was the operator of the vehicle that was struck on the driver's side. Driver 2 was traevling through
the intersection from the cross street. A Passenger was also in Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported back pain and
was evaluated at the scene. The reported injury is consistent with the direction and force of the impact. Damage to
both vehicles is largely consistent with the collision as described. I could not determine with certainty which seat
Driver 1 occupied at the moment of impact, though Driver 1 stated it was the driver's position. Witness statements,
scene photographs, and Driver 2's account all match the sequence of events Driver 1 described. No prior damage to
Driver 1's vehicle was observed or reported. Records checked at the scene show that Driver 1 is listed on the
vehicle's insurance policy. No citations were issued at this time pending further review.
</page>
